title: Lighthouse Health — on-prem weekly sync prep (scratch)
content:
Purpose: personal scratch for the weekly Lighthouse Health on-prem/VPC project sync (Thu 10/24). Use this to drive the 30-min cadence: prep topics, quick status, blockers, and owners. Keep short — callouts only.

Context snapshot (1-liner): Lighthouse is targeting a phased private deployment (VPC peered to their GCP project -> dedicated on-prem serving cluster for PHI workflows). Customer priority: latency and HIPAA controls, target MPT (minimal production threshold) by end of Nov.

Agenda (30m):
- 0–5m quick run: rollout timeline check (are we still on the Nov MPT?)
- 5–12m infra open items: network/security signoffs, tunnel testing, certs
- 12–20m runtime readiness: model bundle sizing, quantization profile, batch settings, obs hooks
- 20–26m handoffs: SRE/ops runbook, on-call rotation, rollback plan
- 26–30m actions + owners + quick risks

Key status bullets (quick):
- Network: VPC peering approved on LH side, awaiting firewall rule list (Ravi) — currently blocked for staging smoke tests.
- Certs: customer CA root delivered 10/14; we still need intermediate cert chain from their infra team (Maya following up).
- Cluster: on-prem infra team completed base k8s (v1.26) — need node label schema for GPU pools (Samir).
- Model bundle: finalizing 7B quantized bundle; size estimate ~9.2GB (compressed). Pending perf perf test at 512 token context (me).
- Observability: tracing hooks added, but token-level cost breakdown not wired to their metrics stack yet. Need agent config for Prometheus -> LH GCP (Nora).

Open/blockers (priority order):
1) Firewall / NAT rules for egress to Redwood telemetry endpoints — LH security needs exact host list + IP ranges. Owner: Ravi. Blocker for staging validation.
2) Intermediate cert chain missing; without it we can't complete TLS validation for private API. Owner: Maya.
3) Node labeling + GPU partition plan not finalized (need gpu-type tags + tolerations). Owner: Samir. Impact: resource scheduling in canary.
4) Privacy review: data-at-rest KMS integration questions — customer legal asked about HSM support (ticket SEC-88). Owner: Elena (me) to coordinate with Security.

Questions to bring to the sync (quick):
- Does LH infra commit to providing the full firewall list by EOD Mon 10/28? If no, what's their proposed alternate?
- Can LH confirm support window for on-site engineer during initial cutover (we asked for day-0 overlap)?
- Preferred rollback signal: do they want full traffic cut or gradual weight-back to hosted endpoints?

Preflight checklist (for this week's goals):
- [ ] Firewall IP list received and validated (Ravi)
- [ ] Intermediate cert chain in place and accepted in staging (Maya)
- [ ] Node labels and GPU pool annotation applied in cluster template (Samir)
- [ ] Canary: small traffic test config (10%) and A/B route created (Elena)
- [ ] Runbook draft uploaded to Confluence + run-through scheduled with LH SRE (Nora)
- [ ] KMS/HSM compatibility doc shared with LH legal (Elena)

Quick runbook notes (things to flag in doc):
- Health checks: use /internal/ready and /internal/live endpoints — these must map to k8s readinessProbe with 2s initialDelay.
- Rollback: tagged images with yyyy-mm-dd build tag; rollback to previous tag + scale down new ReplicaSet to 0 and remove A/B route. Also keep DB snapshots for 24h.
- Telemetry: telemetry endpoints are outbound-only; ensure firewall allows 52.23.10.0/24 and telemetry.redwood.ai FQDN.

Owner action matrix (short):
- Ravi S. — collect firewall + NAT rules from LH (due: 2024-10-28)
- Maya O. — intermediate cert chain + cert install verification (due: 2024-10-21) [NOTE: overdue, chase during sync]
- Samir P. — finalize node labeling plan + post cluster patch (due: 2024-10-23)
- Nora K. — push Prometheus scrape config + demo to LH metrics (due: 2024-10-25)
- Elena M. (me) — perf runs for quantized bundle, update canary config, author KMS compatibility note (due: 2024-10-24)

Risks & mitigation thoughts (to discuss quickly):
- Risk: cert delay causes full-week slip -> mitigation: temp wildcard tunnel with stricter IP allowlist for staging only (short-lived).
- Risk: GPU shortage for canary -> mitigation: run mixed-precision test on CPU instance for functional smoke and hold perf to later stage; keep customers informed.
- Risk: legal holds for HSM -> mitigation: offer architectural alternatives (bring-your-own-HSM vs. transient in-cloud KMS with strict logging).

Notes-to-self (things to remember):
- Bring up SEC-88 on the call; have one-sentence explanation of HSM tradeoffs.
- Ask for LH contact who will do cert installs (name + pager).
- If firewall list delayed, propose a short Zoom with their infra lead to unblock.

Post-sync quick template (copy out after meeting):
- Summary (1 line): "Stability check + blockers identified: certs and firewall list. Plan to target next canary 10/30 if items resolved"
- Actions assigned (bullet list: owner — task — due)
- Next sync: Thu 10/31 09:30 PT (confirm)

---
Scratch history: started 2024-10-15 during prep; added perf numbers and node notes 2024-10-18; updated owners after SRE huddle 2024-10-22.

Random quick logs (for traceability):
- 2024-10-17 14:02: perf run #1 (7B q4_0): median latency 78ms @ 64 tokens; 512 tokens still failing memory threshold on 16GB GPU — need to try q8_0 or reduce batch.
- 2024-10-20 09:30: LH infra confirmed k8s control plane reachable from our bastion (SSH test OK).

End scratch — prune before publishing to shared drive.
